!
interface Loopback1

!

!

!

  pass

!
router ospf CORE

  interface Loopback0
   cost 1
   passive enable
  !
  interface TenGigE0/0/0/0
   cost 10
   network point-to-point
  !
 !
!
router bgp 64502

  network 192.0.2.64/27
  network 203.0.113.128/26
 !

  remote-as 64502

  update-source Loopback0
  address-family ipv4 unicast
  !
 !
!
